title: Emerald Armor And Tools!
description: This Mod adds Emerald Armor & Tools to the game!! Its Craftable. Now how good is it Better then diamond Worse Then Netherite
body:
# 🌿 Emerald Armor & Tools

Have you always felt that emeralds were lacking a purpose outside of villager trading? This vanilla-friendly Fabric mod finally grants that long-awaited feature by bringing fully craftable **Emerald Armor and Tools** into Minecraft! 

Perfect for survival progression _(does not need cheats)_ , creative mode building, or messing around with `/give` cheats.

## 🚀 Features
* **Full Armor Set:** Craft a complete set of Emerald Armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots) to stay protected in style.
* **Complete Toolset:** Upgrade your gear with the Emerald Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe.
* **100% Craftable:** All items utilize standard vanilla crafting patterns using your hoarded emerald gems.

## 📋 Requirements & Compatibility
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11 (Required)
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Dependency:** Fabric API

## 🔮 Future Plans
This mod is actively maintained! Planned features for upcoming updates include:
* 🐴 Emerald Horse Armor
* 🔱 Emerald Spears
* ⬆️ Minecraft V26+
